sources.note: The store operator is identified as Shenzhen Neewer Technology Co., Ltd.
The illustration labels NW-ETZ and NW-ETZ PRO separately and identifies the rubber sealing ring and coated PCB on NW-ETZ PRO.

notes: NEEWER states that the rubber sealing ring improves resistance to water and dust; no ingress-protection rating is specified on the product page.
The manufacturer lists dimensions as 67 x 7.5 mm without identifying the measurement axes.
The manufacturer advertises firmware updates using the supplied USB cable.
